typography.primary: Microsoft YaHei UI / Noto Sans SC / system sans

shared_visual_core.material: Flat printed field guide with a quiet 48px technical grid
shared_visual_core.shape_and_line: Hard editorial rules, one clipped warning shape, flat index squares and two decisive color fields; no rounded SaaS panels
shared_visual_core.image_treatment: No decorative imagery; typography, index geometry and semantic color carry the composition
shared_visual_core.hierarchy_and_rhythm: Large asymmetric cover → four-way diagnosis strip → two-column method directory → continue-or-stop color split → dark human-agency footer

static_composition.capacity: One continuous poster with four diagnosis states, six actions, two exit conditions and one closing statement
static_composition.grid: 48px blue side rail, 94px content origin, 1264px main width, four-column diagnosis, two-column methods and two-column decision split
static_composition.reading_order: Cover promise → classify the failure → choose one of six actions → continue or stop → return judgment to the person
static_composition.preview: Inspect the complete 1440 × 2160 canvas and a 360px-wide thumbnail
